final_message:
The bug was in `_eligible` in `billing/discounts.py`. The plan-restriction check was inverted. It read `price_id is None and plan_of.get(price_id) in plans`, so a line with a real price never matched the coupon's plans. I changed it to `price_id is not None and ...`.

I ran your test and it passes, along with the existing 25 tests. I used a temporary test file and deleted it afterwards, so the test isn't in the suite. I didn't run mypy.

I also wrote `answer.json` in the repo root as `{"file": "discounts.py", "function": "_eligible"}`. `.gitignore` ignores that file, so it won't show up in `git status`.

steps.command: cd billing && ls && cat discounts.py && grep -rn "applies_to_plans\|discount_amount" . | grep -v "^./discounts.py"

cd .. && sed -i 's/return price_id is None and plan_of/return price_id is not None and plan_of/' billing/discounts.py && sed -n 135,162p billing/invoices.py && echo '{"file": "discounts.py", "function": "_eligible"}' > answer.json && cat > /tmp/t.py <<'E'
E
cat >> tests/test_plan_coupon_tmp.py <<'E'
from billing import discounts


def test_plan_restricted_coupon(world):
    cus = world.customer()
    coupon = discounts.create_coupon(world.ctx, "team", percent_off=5000, applies_to_plans=[world.team["id"]])
    world.engine.subscribe(cus["id"], [(world.monthly["id"], 1), (world.team_monthly["id"], 1)], coupon_id=coupon["id"])
    [inv] = world.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])
    assert [line["discount_amount"] for line in inv["lines"]] == [0, 1500]
E
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5; rm tests/test_plan_coupon_tmp.py

cat > tests/test_plan_coupon_tmp.py <<'E'
